components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA — create event, retry on error. Black text on yellow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-contrast); font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: KPI Cell
components.description: Icon-led metric tile — label, bold value, detail line. Not a stacked hero metric.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-kpi-cell { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; background: var(--color-background); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; min-width: 0; } .ds-kpi-icon-well { flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--color-surface); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 8px; } .ds-kpi-icon { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--color-foreground-secondary); } .ds-kpi-body { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-kpi-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); margin: 0; } .ds-kpi-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-foreground); margin: 2px 0 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-kpi-detail { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); margin: 2px 0 0; }

components.name: Neutral Fill Bar
components.description: Progress bar for top events and upcoming capacity — never accent yellow.
components.html: 34 sold · 68%
components.css: .ds-fill-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-fill-track { flex: 1; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-surface-muted); overflow: hidden; } .ds-fill-progress { height: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-foreground-secondary); transition: width 300ms ease-out; } .ds-fill-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Chart Range Toggle
components.description: Segmented 1W/4W control; active pill inverts to near-black on white.
components.css: .ds-range-toggle { display: flex; background: var(--color-surface); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 2px; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-range-btn { border: none; background: transparent; border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground-secondary); cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease, background 200ms ease; } .ds-range-btn:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-range-btn-active { background: var(--color-foreground); color: var(--color-background); } .ds-range-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Weekly Chart Bar
components.description: Flat vertical bar — accent for current week, bench grey for prior weeks.

components.css: .ds-chart-bar-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex: 1; min-width: 0; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chart-value { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-foreground); } .ds-chart-slot { width: 100%; max-width: 48px; height: 112px; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; } .ds-chart-bar { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0 0; background: var(--color-surface-muted); transition: height 300ms ease-out; min-height: 10%; } .ds-chart-bar-current { background: var(--color-accent); } .ds-chart-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); }

components.css: .ds-event-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; border-radius: var(--radius); text-decoration: none; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-event-row:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover); } .ds-event-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-event-thumb { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-surface-muted); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-event-content { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-event-name { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground); margin: 0; } .ds-event-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); margin: 2px 0 0; } .ds-status-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 6px; } .ds-status-dot-partial { background: var(--color-surface-muted); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-status-dot-near { background: var(--color-foreground-secondary); } .ds-status-dot-full { background: var(--color-foreground); }

components.name: Quick Nav Tile
components.description: Equal-width shortcut tile in five-column grid.
components.html: Create event
components.css: .ds-quick-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 4.5rem; padding: 12px 8px; background: var(--color-background); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); text-decoration: none; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background 200ms ease; } .ds-quick-tile:hover { background: var(--color-surface-hover); } .ds-quick-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quick-icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: var(--color-foreground-secondary); } .ds-quick-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-foreground); text-align: center; line-height: 1.25; }

components.css: .ds-error-card { background: var(--color-background); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: 24px; text-align: center; font-family: Satoshi, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-error-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-foreground); margin: 0; } .ds-error-hint { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); margin: 4px 0 0; } .ds-error-retry { margin-top: 16px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-accent-contrast); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer; transition: filter 200ms ease; } .ds-error-retry:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-error-fallback { font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-foreground-muted); margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-error-fallback a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; } .ds-error-fallback a:hover { color: var(--color-foreground); }

narrative.overview: SPORTSHUB looks like the digital front desk of a well-run local sports club—not enterprise SaaS, not a neon fitness app. The interface is calm, compact, and legible on a phone between sessions. White cards sit on a soft grey canvas; near-black text stays readable without harsh pure-black slabs. Sports yellow appears only where action or focus is needed: primary CTAs, the current-week chart bar, and focus rings.
keyCharacteristics: Black, white, and a short grey ladder—no decorative gradients in app chrome
One corner radius (12px) across panels, cards, and controls; 8px for nested wells
Yellow accent with black text on filled accent surfaces; yellow only on CTAs and current-week chart bars
Neutral fill bars (surface-muted track, foreground-secondary fill) for progress encoding
Borders over shadows; elevation is rare
Icon-led KPI cells, five-tile quick nav, inline error recovery on organiser v2 dashboard

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Yellow appears on primary actions, focus, and the current-week chart bar—not on fill bars, status dots, KPI icons, or nav hover fills.

rules.name: The Neutral Bar Rule
rules.body: Progress and ranking bars use surface-muted tracks with foreground-secondary fills. Accent yellow never encodes fill percentage.

rules.name: The 16px Input Rule
rules.body: Form controls on mobile use ≥16px font size to prevent iOS zoom-on-focus.

rules.name: The No Stack Rule
rules.body: Do not combine filled grey panels, heavy borders, and shadows on the same component.

dos: Do write SPORTSHUB in all caps in UI and marketing copy.
Do use semantic tokens from globals.css for new UI.
Do keep yellow for primary CTAs, focus, and the current-week chart bar—not fill bars or status encoding.
Do use black (#0A0A0A) text on yellow buttons.
Do label metrics honestly when data is lifetime or approximate.
Do use icon-led KPI cells with sentence-case labels—not uppercase hero-metric stacks.
Do offer inline retry when dashboard data fails to load.
donts: Don't introduce new greys or radii outside the token ladder without updating :root.
Don't use Space Grotesk or other display fonts—Satoshi only.
Don't stack shadow + thick border + grey fill on one element.
Don't use legacy organiser-light-gray, raw gray-*, or hardcoded greys on new organiser surfaces.
Don't use accent yellow on fill bars, KPI icon wells, or status dots—neutral encoding only.
Don't fabricate social proof, benchmarks, or analytics the product cannot source.
